**Division:** Industrial Energy Systems
**Period:** Quarter Ended September 30, 2026
**Prepared by:** Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

## 1. Executive Summary
The division recorded solid commercial activity during the third quarter. Gross revenues advanced to $18,450,000 against a target budget of $18,000,000. Operating gross margins stood at 39.3% ($7,250,000). Total operating income before tax reached $1,350,000.

## 2. Income Statement (Preliminary Internal Figures)

| **Gross Margin** | $7,250,000 | $7,000,000 | +$250,000 |

| **Selling, General & Admin (SG&A)** | $2,100,000 | $2,150,000 | -$50,000 |
| **Facility & Utilities Overhead** | $950,000 | $950,000 | $0 |

# Q3 2026 Independent External Audit Review
**Auditor:** Apex Assurance & Advisory LLP
**Engagement:** Quarterly Review of Energy Systems Division
**Date of Audit Review:** October 3, 2026
**Standard:** IFRS-15 / ASC 606 & IAS 2

## 1. Audit Opinion & Executive Summary
We have completed our interim audit inspection of the Q3 records. Our audit revealed significant accounting adjustments resulting in major variances against internal management reporting. Specifically, unearned revenue was improperly recognized, shipping expenses and inventory scrap were unrecorded, and development prototyping was incorrectly capitalized.

## 2. Audited Operating Figures & Required Adjustments
All amounts in USD:

| Line Item | Audited Q3 Actual | Internal Stated | Audit Adjustment / Variance |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Gross Revenue** | $17,600,000 | $18,450,000 | -$850,000 |
| **Cost of Goods Sold (COGS)** | $11,620,000 | $11,200,000 | +$420,000 |
| **Gross Margin** | $5,980,000 | $7,250,000 | -$1,270,000 |
| **R&D Expenses** | $3,100,000 | $2,850,000 | +$250,000 |
| **Selling, General & Admin (SG&A)** | $1,980,000 | $2,100,000 | -$120,000 |
| **Facility & Utilities Overhead** | $950,000 | $950,000 | $0 |
| **Total Operating Expenses (OPEX)** | $6,030,000 | $5,900,000 | +$130,000 |
| **Operating Income (EBIT)** | -$50,000 (Loss) | $1,350,000 | -$1,400,000 |
| **Net Financing / Interest Expense** | $180,000 | $180,000 | $0 |
| **Tax Benefit / Provision** | -$57,500 | $292,500 | -$350,000 |
| **Audited Net Income / (Loss)** | **-$172,500** | **$877,500** | **-$1,050,000** |

## 3. Detailed Audit Finding Notes & Root Causes
1. **Revenue Deferral (-$850,000)**: Project Titan Milestone 2 was billed prior to customer operational acceptance. Under ASC 606 / IFRS-15, recognition must be deferred to Q4 upon commissioning sign-off.
2. **COGS Understatement (+$420,000)**: Management omitted transit shipping accruals ($270,000) and defective rotor scrap write-offs ($150,000), totaling an adverse $420,000 adjustment.
3. **R&D Expense Reclassification (+$250,000)**: Turbine Series-7 prototyping expenditures fail capitalization criteria under IAS 38 and must be immediately expensed in period OPEX.
4. **SG&A Supplier Rebate (-$120,000)**: Valid annual vendor incentive rebate received in September was correctly credited to SG&A expenses.
5. **Net Impact**: The division swung from a reported internal profit of +$877,500 to an audited comprehensive net loss of -$172,500 (total variance of -$1,050,000).

--- END ATTACHED FILE: q3_external_audit_report.md ---

### Root Causes of Discrepancies

1. **Revenue Deferral (-$850,000)**: Project Titan Milestone 2 ($850,000) was billed on September 28 but recognized prematurely. Under **ASC 606 / IFRS-15**, revenue must be deferred until customer operational acceptance/commissioning sign-off (Q4).

4. **SG&A Supplier Rebate (-$120,000)**: Valid annual vendor incentive rebate received in September was correctly credited to SG&A.

| Standard | Requirement | Compliance |

| IAS 2 | Inventory valuation including all costs | **NON-COMPLIANT** (shipping accruals omitted) |
| IAS 38 | Development expenditure capitalization criteria | **NON-COMPLIANT** (Turbine Series-7 prototyping) |

### Financial Impact

- **Internal Reported Net Income:** +$877,500 (profit)
- **Audited Net Income:** -$172,500 (loss)
- **Total Variance:** **-$1,050,000**
